statements.status_notes: Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-86469

Disputed by vendor. The existence of the g_str_hash function is not a vulnerability in the library, because callers of g_hash_table_new and g_hash_table_new_full can specify an arbitrary hash function that is appropriate for the application.
